schedule.reason: committed finish 2027-01-19 is on or before the target 2027-02-26

quality.reason: 25 of 25 legacy statements validated by parity, 0 open divergences

risk.reason: 1 high finding without an agreed decision

findings.title: OrderService.insertOrder writes 3 collections in one transaction
findings.evidence: @Transactional; writes items, orders, sequences via updateInventoryQuantity, insertOrder, insertOrderStatus, insertLineItem, getSequence, updateSequence
findings.action: Needs a multi-document transaction (replica set, as on Atlas) or a redesign so the write lands in one document; agree which with the customer architect

findings.title: Order ids come from a read-then-write sequence
findings.evidence: OrderService reads getSequence then writes updateSequence with no lock: two concurrent orders can get the same id
findings.action: Replace with an atomic findOneAndUpdate($inc); confirm the id format stays the same for the customer's reports

findings.title: Passwords are stored in plain text
findings.evidence: SIGNON.PASSWORD is varchar(25), compared directly in SQL
findings.action: Out of scope for a like-for-like migration: raise with the customer's security lead and agree a hashing change as a separate, tested step

findings.title: 6 reads use inner joins that hide rows
findings.evidence: e.g. getAccountByUsername, getAccountByUsernameAndPassword, getItem, getItemListByProduct: a missing profile, banner, status or inventory row drops the result
findings.action: Keep the legacy behaviour unless the customer decides otherwise; parity tests pin it

findings.title: Search passes user input into SQL LIKE
findings.evidence: searchProductList: % and _ typed by a user are wildcards
findings.action: Translate LIKE exactly (anchored regex on a lower-cased copy of the name, indexed); flag the wildcard behaviour to the product owner

findings.title: Money columns are DECIMAL
findings.evidence: listprice, unitcost, unitprice, totalprice are decimal(10,2)
findings.action: Store as Decimal128, never as double; reconcile totals after the data migration

findings.title: Child tables have no foreign keys
findings.evidence: lineitem, orderstatus, inventory can hold orphan rows
findings.action: Count orphans in the customer's production copy before migration; agree whether to drop or quarantine them

decisions.decision: Order, status and line items become one document, written atomically; the stock decrement and the order insert run in one multi-document transaction on the Atlas replica set
Order ids move to an atomic findOneAndUpdate($inc) on the sequences collection; id format unchanged
Keep legacy inner-join behaviour (accounts without a banner, orders without a status are not returned); parity tests pin it
Keep % and _ as wildcards in search for this release; product owner to decide on escaping afterwards
Money as Decimal128; totals reconciled after each migration rehearsal
